integrity: All proof claims are supported by exact path concatenation, a support-incidence rank lemma, and a transfer determinant; enumerations are reproducible finite checks, not substitutes for general proof.
scientific_limitations: Only uniformly oriented cycles with n>=3 and path truncation J^4; no claim about geometry of nonreduced schemes, alternate truncation lengths, or historical publication priority. Proof is self-contained; independently validated by no outside reviewer.
title: Square-zero elements in Loewy-length-four cyclic Nakayama algebras: a universal fourth-order recurrence
